questionText: Pick one or more CORRECT statement(s) from the choices given below, in the context of upstream and downstream cut-offs provided below the concrete apron of weirs / barrages constructed across alluvial rivers.

options.html: Cut-offs are provided to increase the rate of flow over the weir / barrage.
options.text: Cut-offs are provided to increase the rate of flow over the weir / barrage.

options.html: Cut-offs are provided to increase the seepage length and prevent failure due to piping.
options.text: Cut-offs are provided to increase the seepage length and prevent failure due to piping.

options.html: The bottom level of cut-offs mainly depends on the scour depth.
options.text: The bottom level of cut-offs mainly depends on the scour depth.

options.html: Cut-offs are provided to ensure occurrence of hydraulic jump within the stilling basin.
options.text: Cut-offs are provided to ensure occurrence of hydraulic jump within the stilling basin.

explanationHtml:
Statement (A):
Cut-offs are not related to increasing the rate of flow over the weir or barrage. Their primary function is structural and related to seepage control.
This statement is incorrect.

Statement (B):
Cut-offs increase the seepage path (or seepage length), which helps in reducing the exit gradient and thereby prevents piping failure beneath the structure.
This statement is correct.

Statement (C):
The depth of cut-offs is generally determined based on the expected scour depth to ensure stability and prevent undermining of the structure.
This statement is correct.

Statement (D):
Hydraulic jump is controlled by the design of the stilling basin and energy dissipation arrangements (like baffle blocks, floor slopes). Cut-offs are not directly provided for hydraulic jump formation.
This statement is incorrect.
